topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture on complement and sets expectations for the material.

topics.label: Fundamentals and core principles of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the basic properties, naming conventions, and central C3 activation hub of the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three biochemical pathways that initiate complement recognition and converge to reach the activation threshold.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the primary downstream outcomes of complement activation that eliminate pathogens and promote inflammation.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that protect host cells from accidental complement-mediated attack.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the distinct clinical presentations and pathology associated with deficiencies across different complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the strategies and virulence factors pathogens utilize to circumvent complement-mediated immunity.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture on complement and provides framing for the next session on the adaptive immune system.
